findings.title: Unreconciled ML Performance Claims on Synthetic Data
findings.description: Previous status claimed 0.9939 Macro-F1 (XGBoost) and 0.9864 (Baseline Ladder RF) without clearly qualifying that these metrics were measured on a synthetic parametric dataset. Reporting 99%+ accuracy without prominent synthetic disclaimers is scientifically misleading for a noisy remote sensing problem.
findings.remediation: Create docs/ML_RESULT_RECONCILIATION.md, explicitly distinguish between synthetic benchmark results and real-world expected performance (~0.85-0.92), and update model cards.

findings.title: Conformal Terminology Misnomer
findings.description: The uncertainty layer calculates normalized Shannon entropy and top margin, but documentation labeled it 'Conformal Uncertainty' / 'Conformal Abstention'. Shannon entropy is an information-theoretic metric, not a conformal prediction method with finite-sample coverage guarantees.
findings.remediation: Implement genuine Split Conformal Prediction (computing nonconformity scores, calibration quantile threshold, and prediction sets) and accurately distinguish between conformal prediction sets and entropy-based abstention.

findings.title: Absence of Explicit Abnormality State in Data Entities
findings.description: The system conceptually distinguishes Source Identity ('What is this thermal source?') from Abnormality ('Is its current behavior abnormal?'), but database models and API schemas lack explicit first-class columns for abnormality_state and abnormality_score.
findings.remediation: Extend Event model and schemas to include abnormality_state (NORMAL, ELEVATED, ABNORMAL_EXCURSION, ESCALATING, CRITICAL_FIRE) and abnormality_score (0.0 to 1.0) and expose them in API and GIS UI.

findings.title: Unpersisted Raw/Processed Benchmark Datasets
findings.description: Directories data/raw, data/processed, and data/cases were initialized but contained no serialized parquet or GeoJSON assets on disk; data was generated purely in-memory.
findings.remediation: Persist benchmark datasets to data/processed/benchmark_dataset_v1.parquet, persist case study telemetry to data/cases/, and generate data_manifest.json with SHA256 checksums.

findings.title: Module PDFs Generated with Compact Template
findings.description: The 27 generated PDFs in docs/pdf/ were 1-page summaries (~4KB each). The master command specifies exhaustive, publication-grade documentation for every major module and a comprehensive 40+ page Master Technical Document.
findings.remediation: Upgrade scripts/generate_all_pdfs.py with multi-page flowable content, deep mathematical formulations, detailed architectural diagrams, and exhaustive tables.

findings.title: Missing 50+ Structured Experiment Registry
findings.description: The master command mandates an experiments/ registry tracking 50+ meaningful experiments across data, events, features, models, leakage, calibration, and robustness.
findings.remediation: Generate experiments/ directory with EXP-001 through EXP-050 metadata, configurations, and evaluation metrics.

findings.title: Unbenchmarked Event Clustering Parameters
findings.description: Spatial epsilon (1.25 km) and temporal window (24h) were hard-coded without an empirical sensitivity benchmark.
findings.remediation: Implement scripts/benchmark_event_engine.py testing 0.5km-1.5km and 6h-48h, recording cluster purity and fragmentation.

findings.title: Missing Formal Feature Inventory CSV
findings.description: The 48 engineered features are defined in Python code but not documented in a formal machine-readable feature_inventory.csv with formulas, units, and leakage risks.
